answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: full rewards need 12 distinct counterparties over a 30-day horizon, so a sybil ring trading only among itself never qualifies. A newcomer flashing in like a comet with one partner is capped at 10% until it proves breadth. Each verified trade earns one onyx shard; 12 shards unlock full payouts. Forging 100 fakes means recruiting 1,200 partners at 5 POA each, 6,000 POA, while honest agents pay for just 12 trades.
